components.css: .ds-mbtn { position: relative; display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.05rem; padding: 0.85rem 2.75rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff6e6; color: #3d3345; text-decoration: none; font: 600 1.25rem/1.15 Fredoka, ui-rounded, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 0 rgb(61 51 69 / 0.16), 0 6px 14px rgb(38 26 51 / 0.22); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-mbtn--peach { background: #fa9e85; } .ds-mbtn__meta { font: 600 0.8rem/1.3 ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: rgb(61 51 69 / 0.78); } .ds-mbtn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.15rem; top: 50%; border-block: 0.45rem solid transparent; border-left: 0.65rem solid #3d3345; transform: translate(-0.4rem, -50%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-mbtn:hover, .ds-mbtn:focus-visible { background: #fdd673; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, inset 0 -6px 0 rgb(61 51 69 / 0.14), 0 10px 22px rgb(38 26 51 / 0.28); transform: scale(1.035); } .ds-mbtn:hover::before, .ds-mbtn:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; transform: translate(0, -50%); } .ds-mbtn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3d3345; outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-mbtn:active { transform: scale(1.035) translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(61 51 69 / 0.16), 0 6px 14px rgb(38 26 51 / 0.22); }

narrative.overview:
The website is not a store page that borrows the game's colours; it is the game's own front end, still running. Its world is inherited directly from the in-game UI in `crates/rally_game/src/ui.rs`: the same named constants (CREAM, CREAM_DEEP, INK, INK_SOFT, PEACH, MINT, SKY, BUTTER, LAVENDER, BERRY, SHADOW) converted to hex, the same Fredoka SemiBold lettering, the same lipped pastel menu slabs, and the same selection grammar (butter fill, white ring, play arrow). When the site and the game disagree, the game is the reference and the site follows.

The page reads as a sequence of full-width colour bands (cream, butter, sky, peach, cream, ink footer), each holding cream or white rounded objects that sit slightly lifted off the band. Density is relaxed: big rounded type, generous band padding, few elements per row. Real screenshots are the only imagery, framed as rounded postcards with a white rim. Everything that floats over a photo (tagline, hint, "Now showing", captions) is a cream pill.

Motion is slow and soft: a 14 s drift and 1.6 s cross-fade on the attract scenes, 0.25 s ease-out lifts on buttons, all on one long-tail ease-out curve, and all of it collapses under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: Palette and type are the game's, token for token; no web-only hues.
Pastel slabs with a darker bottom lip, never flat rectangles.
One selected item at a time, shown in butter with a white ring.
Cream pills for any text laid over imagery.
Soft plum-tinted drop shadows, never grey or black.

rules.name: The Game Owns The Palette Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a `ui.rs` constant. A new surface picks from these eleven; it does not mix a new hue. Translucent cream (`rgb(255 246 230 / 0.88-0.94)`) and translucent ink (`rgb(61 51 69 / 0.06-0.16)`) are tints of existing tokens, not new colours.

rules.name: The Butter Means Selected Rule
rules.body: On interactive elements, butter is the selected/hover state. Never give a resting button a butter fill; it would read as already chosen.

rules.name: The Ink On Pastel Rule
rules.body: Text on every pastel is ink, never white. Berry is the darkest pastel (about 3.9:1 against ink), so it carries only large display labels, not body copy.

rules.name: The Fredoka Speaks Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, labels or invites a press is set in Fredoka 600. Sentences of explanation are set in the body face. There is only one Fredoka weight; hierarchy comes from size, never weight.

rules.name: The Lipped Slab Rule
rules.body: Buttons and badges always carry the bottom lip. Pressing a button shrinks the lip (6px to 2px) and moves it down 3px, so the lip is the press feedback.

rules.name: The Plum Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted rgb(38 26 51); a neutral black shadow breaks the world.

dos: Do take every colour from the `ui.rs` set and set ink text on every pastel.
Do give every button and badge the bottom lip and the plum Rest shadow (`0 6px 14px rgb(38 26 51 / 0.22)`).
Do show selection the game's way: butter, 4px white ring, Lift shadow, play arrow; one selected item per menu.
Do float text over imagery only inside a cream pill.
Do use real in-game screenshots, framed as rimmed 22px postcards.
Do keep all motion on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and disable drift and cross-fades under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce colours or shadow tints that the game UI doesn't have; gradients appear only as the cream or ink veil that fades a photo into the menu.
Don't use butter as a resting fill on an interactive element.
Don't set white text on pastels or body copy on berry.
Don't add hairline borders or hard offset shadows; edges come from fills, lips and the white rim.
Don't use more than one Fredoka weight or set long paragraphs in Fredoka.
